name: One Cascade per Mutation Field
description: When an operation contains several mutation fields, each field's payload MUST carry its own cascade, describing only the changes made by that field

input.mutation: mutation BatchUpdate { updateUser1: updateUser(id: "1", name: "User 1") { data { id name } cascade { updated { typename id operation entity } deleted { typename id } invalidations { queryName strategy scope } typeInvalidations { typename } metadata { affectedCount } } } updateUser2: updateUser(id: "2", name: "User 2") { data { id name } cascade { updated { typename id operation entity } deleted { typename id } invalidations { queryName strategy scope } typeInvalidations { typename } metadata { affectedCount } } } }
